title: Research: the Monitor tool's limits, a -p run's wait for background work, Edit and Write PreToolUse payloads and a mod's ui.notify are kb facts
goal: kb/public/claude/hooks.md, ci-and-headless.md and mods.md gain DOC facts with source rows from code.claude.com: the Monitor tool (a command whose stdout lines are events, its timeout_ms default 300000, accepted maximum and 1800000 effective deadline, the notice at the deadline, Bash permission rules); a -p run staying open for background commands, subagents and Monitor watches with the 10-minute idle cap and CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS; the PreToolUse payload of Edit and Write (tool_input.file_path) and a matcher naming them; and a mod's $.ui.notify (the preferredNotifChannel it uses, its isSent and reason answers, no-surface in -p runs) with the turn.complete event

run:
import subprocess, sys
ART = 'kb/public/claude/hooks.md'
CASES = [('How long can a Claude Code Monitor tool watch run before its deadline?', ['Monitor', '1800000'])]
miss = []
for q, terms in CASES:
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', q, '--root', 'public', '--budget', '2500'],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('- ' + ART[len('kb/'):] + ':') and '[DOC' in l
           and all(t.lower() in l.lower() for t in terms)]
    if not hit:
        miss.append((q, terms))
print('missing:', miss if miss else 'none')
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
